categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the digital communication cable industry, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of data cables, specialized cables, and connection products. The company provides comprehensive wiring system solutions for data centers, AI computing centers, intelligent buildings, industrial interconnection, automotive Ethernet, smart homes, and special applications such as medical, wind energy, rail transit, photovoltaic, industrial robots, nuclear power, and aerospace sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing processes for high-speed data transmission cables including categories 5e to 8, high-frequency parallel transmission cables supporting up to 224Gb/s, and high-density optical and copper interconnection technologies. It integrates technologies such as PCIe 5.0/6.0, MCIO, Gen-Z, and active copper cables with embedded digital signal processors. The production includes automated assembly lines, electromagnetic simulation for connector design, and extensive R&D in materials like high flame retardant and low-toxicity polymers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global electronic and communication industry leaders, cloud computing and internet companies, data center operators, industrial automation enterprises, automotive manufacturers, and smart building developers. The company serves markets requiring high-speed, reliable data transmission such as enterprise networks, financial data centers, AI computing centers, industrial Ethernet, machine vision, and specialized equipment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with significant international presence through subsidiaries in Singapore and Thailand. Its products are sold to over 100 countries and regions worldwide, with overseas sales accounting for approximately 62% of total revenue. It has established localized service networks in major Chinese cities and Southeast Asia to support global customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Zhaolong Interconnect Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and assembly of data transmission cables, specialized cables, and connection components. It sources raw materials such as copper rods and polymer insulation materials and delivers finished cable and connector products to downstream customers including data center operators and industrial clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in high-speed data transmission, industrial communication, and integrated wiring system solutions. R&D efforts focus on developing ultra-high frequency cables, low-loss optical connectors, active copper cables, and specialized industrial cables with enhanced durability. It actively collaborates with top universities and research institutes to advance materials science and signal integrity technologies, aiming to maintain leadership in emerging AI, cloud computing, and industrial IoT markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of physical products including data communication cables, specialized cables, connection products, and comprehensive wiring system solutions. The company operates on a make-to-order basis, fulfilling customer-specific technical and quality requirements. It also derives income from related services such as technical support and customized solution design.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhaolong Interconnect is a leading domestic player in China's digital communication cable sector with significant scale and technology advantages. It ranks among the top in market share and innovation capability for high-end structured cabling and high-speed interconnect products. The company competes with both domestic and international cable manufacturers and connector suppliers, positioning itself as a key supplier to major cloud, internet, and industrial enterprises.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.83 billion, representing a 17.73% year-over-year increase, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 153 million, a 55.9% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.49 billion, up 18.29% from the previous year. The company has demonstrated steady growth driven by expanding high-value product lines and international market penetration.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Zhaolong Interconnect emphasizes its comprehensive product portfolio covering high-speed data cables, specialized industrial cables, and advanced connection components with superior signal integrity and electromagnetic compatibility. Its value proposition includes end-to-end wiring system solutions tailored for diverse applications, high reliability, and compliance with international standards. The company leverages strong R&D capabilities and quality certifications to differentiate itself by delivering innovative, high-performance, and customized interconnect solutions that meet evolving digital infrastructure demands.
